text:
alex: Heads up — we're seeing a cluster of noisy GPUs in us-west-2 with recurring Xid 31/43 and ECC count drift. Thinking we should consolidate RMAs into a single depot shipment instead of 4 small ones. Anyone free to coordinate with logistics?

maria: I can pick this up. Can you paste the serials and vendor POs? I'll check which depots accept bulk returns.

simon: quick dump from monitoring: `xid_summary --since 24h --filter region=us-west-2` shows 7 cards flagged, 3 with repeated ECC correctable spikes. Not all are immediate drains but all are failing health checks intermittently.

alex: here's the short list — will triage later but want them bundled:```
SN: GPU-USW2-12345A  model: A100-80GB  errors: Xid43 x5  last_seen: 2026-03-16T18:22Z
SN: GPU-USW2-23456B  model: A100-80GB  errors: ECC-correctable spike x12 last_seen: 2026-03-16T20:01Z
SN: GPU-USW2-34567C  model: A100-80GB  errors: Xid31 x3  last_seen: 2026-03-15T11:40Z
SN: GPU-USW2-45678D  model: A100-80GB  errors: thermal throttle + ECC trend
SN: GPU-USW2-56789E  model: A100-80GB  flaky fans + Xid31
SN: GPU-USW2-67890F  model: A100-80GB  repeated PCIe link resets
SN: GPU-USW2-78901G  model: A100-80GB  ECC uncorrectable spike 1x  last_seen: 2026-03-16T23:05Z
```

jen: tagging logistics and ops: @david @ops-oncall. David — can we get spare swap windows tomorrow morning? Also will vendor accept mixed failure reasons in one RMA manifest?

david: pinged vendor (VEND-98421) to confirm. They said mixed failure reasons are OK if we provide test logs and photos. ETA on auth: 24-36h. Recommend consolidating to LAX depot cross-dock to avoid multiple couriers.

maria: good. For cross-dock, we need a single manifest and barcoded labels. I'll generate a consolidated manifest and QC checklist. Who has photos for SN-78901G (possible UBE)?

simon: I have logs and GPU dumps for 34567C and 78901G, will upload to ticket. Sample nvidia-smi dump:```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.85.12    Driver Version: 525.85.12    CUDA Version: 12.1     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
GPU 0: A100-80GB (UUID: GPU-abcde)
    ECC errors (correctable): 124 -> 482 in 24h
    Xid Errors: 43 (timestamp 2026-03-16T18:22Z)
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

rma-bot: Auto-created ticket VEND-98421-01 for consolidated manifest. Please attach manifest CSV and photos to avoid auth delays. Label set: LAX-DEPOT-3.

alex: ops-oncall — is there a risk for capacity given these drains if we take out 7 cards from the pool? We have a burst window but need to avoid customer impact.

ops-oncall: We'll schedule staggered drains. Can do 3 drains at 06:00PT tomorrow, 4 drains at 09:00PT. Throttle rollout to avoid dropping below 80% GPU capacity for high-priority queues. I'll add a temporary routing rule to shift batch jobs to us-east-1 during windows. :white_check_mark:

maria: Manifest draft attached (CSV format). Columns: serial, model, failure_code, first_seen, vendor_ticket. We'll include test evidence links. Also adding packing instructions: antistatic foam + tamper tag + photo of IMEI/serial on card and chassis.

alex: shipping consolidation saves ~$820 per shipment vs separate couriers. Include cost savings estimate in the vendor ticket for finance review.

david: Vendor confirmed courier preference: UPS Tech-Return or their preferred local partner. If cross-dock at LAX, use this tracking template: `1ZTRACKEXAMPLE{SN_SUFFIX}` — they'll give final tracking after authorization.

jen: small ask — can the warehouse scan and confirm serials as they pack? Last time we had a mismatch on 2 serials. Add a checklist step: scan -> photo -> confirm on manifest.

maria: will do. I'll add a field `warehouse_scan_confirmed` with timestamp. Also want to mark 2 of these cards as high-priority RMA due to UBE/ECC uncorrectable (78901G and 23456B).

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll reserve hot-swap spares in us-west-2 (spare pool IDs: SPARE-WUS-12, SPARE-WUS-13) and hold them for the morning window.

simon: small troubleshooting note — SN-45678D's fan spike may be linked to a thermal profile regression in a recent AMI image. We should mark it as 'investigate SW' in the manifest to avoid immediate RMA if vendor rejects SW-caused failures.

alex: good catch. Put `investigate_ami_regression=true` for 45678D on manifest and attach AMI/boot logs.

rma-bot: Manifest uploaded to VEND-98421-01. Labels printing queued for LAX-DEPOT-3. Authorization pending (24-36h).

maria: I'll coordinate with warehouse to pack today and hold shipment until auth comes through; if auth approved early we'll drop at 14:00PT tomorrow. If not, we'll hold until 06:00PT Saturday to avoid weeknight transfers.

david: courier standby confirmed. I've pushed finance note about cost consolidation and obtained preliminary PO approval.

alex: thanks all. Action items: maria create final manifest + QC, simon attach logs + dumps, david confirm courier + PO, ops-oncall schedule drains and reserve spares. Re-check here when manifest is final.

maria: on it — will post final CSV + scan checklist in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
